question: Approve the ideation of copilot-not-run-line-carries-quote to enter implementation? FO recommends approve; approving accepts that recommendation as designed, enforced on new merge asks only, with the replay counts reported instead of enforced on saved asks.

artifacts.summary: Design: delivery_gate.py refuses a merge ask with no second-reviewer line when the README trigger holds, and a copilot not run line without the printed quote (kept from the saved exit-5 output) and a retry offer. Replay: 47 saved asks newly held (35 already broke the copilot EXTENSION.md rule), 6 not judgeable. Chief-engineer reviewed the whole batch (2026-10-27) and recommends this disposition.
